saw_lines: Nobody buys solid wood furniture on impulse. People pick one piece per room only after picturing it in their own home.
So the sale is won in the ad’s first line, where the buyer decides whether this piece fits their room.
Your 16 copy ads carry no proof number, while your site already shows a 4.2 rating. Put that rating on the creative as the opening line of your next batch.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: None of your 16 copy ads carries a proof number, so a buyer has nothing to trust before the price. Your site already shows a 4.2 rating. Put that number on the creative as the opening line.

Four of your 16 copy ads open on the same allier les matières line, so buyers see one pitch. Test two new openers against it: the style match of industriel, vintage and bohème, and solid wood, marble and terrazzo.
Six of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product in the creative. That extra search costs the sale. Point each of those six to the product page for the piece in its creative.
None of your 16 copy ads carries an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Give them one, a first order offer or a bundle, and open three new ads with it.

ads_1: Paid creative runs style-match and solid-wood hooks, each opening with a first order offer
